$comment: Tier 2b cross-fragment proposals: low-melting sealing-glass consolidation (a), per-site verdicts on the seven Phase-3 leftover ingredient strings (b), and duplicate-substance verdicts (c). All `to` ids exist in the built tree, so every merge below is actionable; input_fixes apply AFTER the merges. Extension keys (input_fixes, ingredient_rows, gap_nodes) follow the 50-power.json precedent (retype/duplicates): they are instructions for owners/maintainer, ignored by applyproposals.mjs.

input_fixes.why: The glass on this part is its vitreous-enamel coating; after the enamel-glass merge the survivor is the consolidated sealing/enamel glass. Applies after merges.
The process IS the enamelling; its glass input is the enamel material, now consolidated into the survivor. Applies after merges.
Ruthenium-oxide tracks screen-printed and fired: the glass is the frit binder in the thick-film paste.
Description says it outright: fired to fuse the glass frit.
Description says it outright: nickel in a glass frit and an organic vehicle.
Silver electrodes glass-bonded to the disc: the glass is the frit in the silver paste.
Silver fired at 700-850 C so it is glass-bonded to the ceramic: same frit.

Deliberately NOT merged: the node describes a real sealing operation (paste, lid, ramp/soak/cool profile) correctly typed as process, but its glass input points at metal.silica (9N polysilicon feedstock, wrong substance) and metal.alumina (the package, not the paste). Re-point the glass input at the consolidated sealing-glass survivor; find or add the organic binder. This is the fourth glass copy, kept as an operation with a corrected material edge.
High-purity natural quartz, mostly Brazilian in 1983: matches the Minas Gerais vein-quartz node. Its second input (sand) stays.
The description names the object: a quartz boat carrying the wafer inside the plastic carrier. The fused-quartz boat node exists and is high-confidence.

No target. Porcelain-body filler quartz: metal.quartz is crystal-grade resonator rock, metal.quartzite is silicon-furnace grade, metal.silica-sand is the closest (ground sand) but the grade is unconfirmed. Do not map; a porcelain-quartz grade node does not exist.
Same as above: porcelain-body filler, no suitable node.

Drop as redundant: the inputs already include 'glass frit', which covers the few per cent of glass in the ZnO disc. If an explicit link is wanted, point it at the (a) survivor after the merges. Never metal.silica (9N polysilicon): the shared name is a trap.
Bulk glass-batch silica for borosilicate microfibre melted at 1400 C; the site already links boric acid and feldspar, so the sand is the remaining batch leg.
Same glass-batch sand as above, coarser grade.
No target. Oxidant air for o-xylene oxidation; the only air node is the baffled ASU intake (facility.nitrogen.atmospheric-air), which is the wrong substance for a reactor feed.
No target. Roast air oxidising sphalerite to ZnO; same wrong-node reason as above.
No target. Oxidation air precipitating acicular gamma-Fe2O3; same wrong-node reason.

No target yet. Bulk technical acid in mixed HF/HNO3/HCl digestion; the only nitric node is electronic grade (chem.fab-chemicals.nitric-acid), and mapping bulk digestion onto it would be wrong-but-resolving. See gap_nodes for the bulk node to create, then point all four nitric sites at it.
No target yet. Hot hydrochloric-nitric leach of sawn rod: bulk acid, same gap as above.
No target yet. Foil etch-bath acid: bulk grade, same gap. Note the description names chloride/chlorate baths, so the owner's retarget should confirm which bath the nitric leg belongs to.
No target yet. Bulk acid dissolving silver to silver nitrate activator; same gap. (Fourth site: the Phase-3 count of three missed this spaced spelling; normalised keys are identical.)
No target. Rammed calcined-coke/graphite/pitch lining and graphitised block: metal.graphite.electrode covers electrodes, anodes and hearth blocks, not lining, so it was considered and rejected.

Same-file retarget, owner's call: isostatic-pressed tooling graphite comes from flake plus pitch binder, which is exactly what the graphite-ore node describes. (Build drops nothing here today; the input is simply unresolved.)
No target. Carbon/graphite pad coating on copper; the composition-resistor mix (graphite plus clay plus binder) is a different substance and was rejected.
Strong match: synthetic iron-oxide browns/reds/blacks as ink and keycap pigments. Same pigment-grade substance.

No target. MnZn-ferrite iron oxide feed; the only ferrite-oxide node is a process (metal.ferrite.iron-oxide-source), and mapping a substance onto a procedure is the serious wrong-kind case. metal.hematite is ore and was rejected.
No target. Hard-ferrite (barium/strontium) iron oxide feed; same wrong-kind and ore rejections as above.

gap_nodes.name: Nitric acid (technical grade)
gap_nodes.why: Four use-sites need bulk technical nitric acid and the tree has only the electronic grade: tantalum HF/HNO3/HCl digestion at 100-200 C, hot hydrochloric-nitric leach of sawn polysilicon rod, aluminium anode-foil etch bath, and silver-nitrate activator make-up. Bulk HCl, H2SO4 and HF all exist beside it, so this is the missing fourth leg. Suggested content: Ostwald route (ammonia over Pt-Rh gauze, absorption to 53-68% technical acid) with inputs on the ammonia chain and air; the four sites above as from-edges. Do NOT widen chem.fab-chemicals.nitric-acid to cover this: electronic grade is a purified grade, the way the tree already treats electronic-grade HF against bulk HF.

gap_nodes.name: Process and combustion air
gap_nodes.why: Three use-sites need oxidant air (o-xylene oxidation, sphalerite roast, iron-oxide precipitation) and the only air node is the baffled ASU intake, which is the wrong substance. No spec offered beyond the name: it needs an owner who will say what it is (blower, header, oil-free compression) rather than a second atmosphere node.

note: Verdicts in brief. (a) Sealing glass consolidates 2-for-1 into peripheral.tv.crt.panel.frit with the ceramic-seal operation kept and re-pointed, not deleted: its ramp/soak/cool profile is a real operation, and deleting it would lose the only account of lid sealing. No new canonical node is created because the richest existing node already names the substance (lead borosilicate sealing frit) and carries the seal profile as facts; generalise its description, do not rename the id. (b) Zero ingredient-table rows are proposed, deliberately: every one of the seven strings splits across substances (glass 5 frit / 2 enamel; quartz porcelain-filler vs resonator quartz vs wafer boat; silica glass-batch sand vs varistor glass phase; air three oxidant uses with no node; nitric four bulk uses with no node; graphite lining vs electrode feed vs pad coating; iron oxide pigment vs two ferrite feeds), so any single mapping would be wrong-but-resolving for at least one site. Per-site fixes above instead. (c) Boric acid merges (same substance, same colemanite route; commodity chemical, application is not identity); nylon 6,6 merges twice into the published polymer (path-local resin copies; fold C64-use sentences first); coke does NOT merge (manufactured metallurgical coke from coking coal vs mined anthracite burned directly: different substances by different routes, the o-xylene precedent). Stale entries found while verifying: c64.case.other-polymers.nylon (40-chassis proposal from) is not in the tree; mb.logic.bipolar.wafer.quartz.coke and si.polysilicon.coke (35-logic/10-silicon proposal endpoints) are not in the tree — all three proposals are void. Sequencing: apply merges, move the 'nylon' and 'nylon 6 6' ingredients rows to chem.polyamide.nylon-66, create the bulk nitric node, then apply input_fixes.
